question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'work'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given passage is about a former captain of an Indian wheelchair-cricket team who was forced to work as a labourer.
 
• The most appropriate word for the given blank is '**work**'.
 
• It means 'to do something which needs physical or mental effort, in order to earn money or to achieve something&
